description: This Dart source file defines the NewsAppState class, which manages the application's news-related state, including fetching news articles from a repository, handling errors, caching saved articles, and state updates for the Flutter UI.

classes.name: NewsAppState
classes.description: A state management class extending ChangeNotifier to handle fetching, caching, and managing news articles along with error handling and user interaction functionalities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app state by loading saved news and fetching categories from the network, with fallbacks to mock data upon errors.

methods.name: articlesFor
methods.description: Returns a list of news articles for a specific category.

methods.name: topHeadlines
methods.description: Returns a list of top news headlines based on the general category.

methods.name: generalDownList
methods.description: Returns a list of additional general news articles excluding top headlines.

methods.name: refreshCategory
methods.description: Fetches and updates news articles for a specific category, with error handling and fallback to mock data.

methods.name: _fetchCategory
methods.description: Internal method to fetch news data for a category from the repository.

methods.name: _useMockForAllCategories
methods.description: Internal method to populate all categories with mock data.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks if an article with the given headline is saved locally.

methods.name: saveArticle
methods.description: Saves or updates an article in the local database and refreshes the saved list.

methods.name: deleteSavedByHeadline
methods.description: Removes a saved article identified by its headline and updates the saved list.
